forge.ForgeCapabilities.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.capabilities.Capabilities
forge.ForgeCapabilities.note: 20.2 只是把 ForgeCapabilities 改名为 Capabilities，常量仍是 ITEM_HANDLER / ENERGY / FLUID_HANDLER / FLUID_HANDLER_ITEM（20.3 起按宿主分组重写）

forge.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider
forge.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider.note: 20.2 仍是 Forge 式 getCapability(cap, side) 返回 LazyOptional<T>

forge.capabilities.CapabilityManager.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.capabilities.CapabilityManager
forge.capabilities.CapabilityManager.note: 仍用 CapabilityManager.get(new CapabilityToken<>(){}) 取得 capability

forge.capabilities.RegisterCapabilitiesE.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.capabilities.RegisterCapabilitiesEvent
forge.capabilities.RegisterCapabilitiesE.note: 20.2 中用于 event.register(接口.class) 注册新 capability 类型（20.3 起含义改变）

forge.event.AttachCapabilitiesEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.AttachCapabilitiesEvent
forge.event.AttachCapabilitiesEvent.note: 20.2 仍可通过 AttachCapabilitiesEvent<T>（游戏总线，泛型事件）给对象附加 capability

mc.block.Block.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block
mc.block.Block.note: 1.20.2 的方块还没有 codec()（1.20.3 引入），BlockBehaviour.Properties.copy(...) 仍可用
